sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fuinjutsu, Genjutsu (Tactile), Earth Release, Water Release

system.description:
You conjure 4 wooden pillars that occupy the space they appear in. Select 4 different spaces you can see on the same surface you are standing on that isn’t occupied by a creature, that hold a pillar that is 10 feet tall and 5 feet thick. This structure is treated as an Earthen Artifact.

This structure has an AC equal to your Ninjutsu save DC, 20 hit points.

Each pillar emits a suppressive aura affecting creatures of your choice within a 10-foot radius of each pillar. Select creatures that begins their turn within the affected radius of a pillar or enter the radius for the first time on a turn, must make a Constitution saving throw taking 2d10 Chakra damage gaining 1 rank of Drained on a failed save or half as much and no further effects on a success. A creature can only be affected by 1 pillars aura per turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and the damage by 1d10. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, summon one additional pillar.
